## Description

Removes the two waivers added by #19572 for `tests/unittest/_torch/disaggregation/test_disagg_coordinator_errors.py`.

Both tests run the real `PyExecutor._handle_responses` on a bare executor. #18397 added an unguarded `self.model_engine` read to that path, so the tests failed with `AttributeError: 'PyExecutor' object has no attribute 'model_engine'` once #19478 and #18397 were both on `main` (each PR was green on its own). #19559 guards the read; the waivers landed after that fix and are stale.

## Test Coverage


- `test_disagg_coordinator_errors.py::test_refused_python_cancel_is_retried_and_settled_through_the_real_response_path`
- `test_disagg_coordinator_errors.py::test_cancelling_part_of_a_saturated_receive_batch_settles_only_those_requests`
